Monday, August 2, 2021
06:30 P.M.
NOTICE AND CALL OF A SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Azusa is hereby called to be held Monday, August 2, 2021 at 06:30 p.m. at AZUSA AUDITORIUM.
Said Special Meeting shall be for discussing, hearing and taking action on the items listed below:
AGENDA
CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY
This City Council Meeting will be in-person and open to the public, observing strict COVID-19 safety precautions. All those attending in-person are required to follow posted guidelines. Those wishing to participate during Public Comment may do so in-person at the Azusa Auditorium, or may submit written public comments by emailing PublicComment@azusaca.gov. Emailed public comments are due by 5:30 p.m. and shall be limited to no more than 250 words. Written public comments will be provided to the City Council and will be part of the record but will not be read aloud.
View the City Council meeting live on the City's website https://www.ci.azusa.ca.us/1389/Watch-Meetings-Online, or on Channel 3 (Spectrum). Archived video of recorded meetings is also available on the City website.
A.
PRELIMINARY BUSINESS
1.
Call to Order
2.
Roll Call
3.
Flag Salute
B.
PUBLIC COMMENT Please note that public comments are welcomed by recognition of the
Mayor, and are limited to items listed on this special meeting agenda.
A Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption for up to three (3) minutes maximum time, only on items appearing on this agenda, and only if a vote is taken, in accordance with the Special Meeting Provisions of the Brown Act. Public Comment will be limited to thirty (30) minutes time
C.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
2021 AZUSA GOLDEN DAYS STATUS REPORT & REVIEW OF DRAFT MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Identify a member of the City Council to serve as Council Liaison to the Azusa Golden Days Committee (voting member); and
2) Review and provide comment on the updated Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to be presented to the Azusa Golden Days nonprofit, to manage risk, clarify roles and responsibilities.
C-1 Staff Report - Azusa Golden Days MOU
D.
CLOSED SESSION
1.

Organization: IBEW (International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers)
Closed Session Report by the City Attorney
E.
COUNCIL COMMENTS
F.
ADJOURNMENT
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk at 626-812-5229. Notification three (3) working days prior to the meeting when special services are needed will assist staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide access to the meeting.

Dalton Ave.; and on the City's Web Page at www.ci.azusa.ca.us .
Adrian Garcia, MMC
Chief Deputy City Clerk
Azusa City Clerk's Office
minutes_text:
CITY OF AZUSA
  MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL
  MONDAY, AUGUST 2, 2021 6:30 P.M.

The City Council of the City of Azusa, met in Special Session at the above date and time in the Azusa Auditorium located
at 213 E. Foothill Blvd, Azusa, CA 91702.

Mayor Gonzales called the meeting to order at 6:30 P.M.

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Charles Alvarez

A. ROLL CALL: Roll call was taken by City Clerk Cornejo.

Councilmember Macias was present via teleconference.

PRESENT: COUNCILMEMBERS: GONZALES, MACIAS, ALVAREZ, AVILA, MENDEZ
ABSENT: COUNCILMEMBERS: NONE

ALSO PRESENT

Elected Officials: City Clerk Cornejo.
Staff Members: City Manager Gonzalez, City Attorney Martinez, Deputy City Manager De Anda-Scaia, Director of
Administrative Services Johnson, Director of Community Resources Carpenter, Chief of Police Bertelsen, and Chief
Deputy City Clerk Garcia.

B. PUBLIC COMMENT

Charles Alvarez showed support of the process of the negotiation between IBEW Local 18 and the City of Azusa; Alvarez
is asking Council and staff to look into the cost of living and retention when reviewing the negotiation.
Gilbert Carlos spoke on behalf of IBEW Local 18 asking the Council to look closely at what IBEW Local 18 is proposing
when going over the negotiation process, such as retention and the cost of living.

C. SCHEDULED ITEMS

1. 2021 AZUSA GOLDEN DAYS STATUS REPORT & REVIEW OF DRAFT MEMORANDUM OF
  UNDERSTANDING.
  Director of Community Resources Carpenter presented a PowerPoint and answered related questions.

  Moved by Councilmember Macias, seconded by Councilmember Mendez, to bring back item at the next City Council
  Meeting motion failed on a 2-3 vote of the Council.

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS: MACIAS, MENDEZ,
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS: AVILA, ALVAREZ, GONZALES

  Moved by Councilmember Gonzales, seconded by Councilmember Avila and carried by the following vote of the
  Council to appoint Councilmember Alvarez to serve as Council Liaison to the Azusa Golden Days Committee as a
  voting member.

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS: MENDEZ, AVILA, ALVAREZ, GONZALES
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS: NONE
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS: MACIAS
 D. CLOSED SESSION

1. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS - Pursuant to California Government Code,
  Section 54957.6.
  City Negotiator: Sergio Gonzalez, City Manager and Talika M. Johnson, Director of Administrative
  Services
  Organization:  IBEW (International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers)

Closed Session Report by the City Attorney

No reportable action.

E. COUNCIL COMMENTS

None.

F. ADJOURNMENT

The meeting was adjourned by consensus of the City Council.

TIME OF ADJOURNMENT: 8:50 P.M.

__________________________________________
CITY CLERK
